heading: Cookie policy
summary: Here's the short version while we finish the full policy.

essential.title: Essential — always on
essential.description: Remembers your cookie choice. Lasts about 6 months.

history.title: History — only if you accept
history.description: Keeps your photos and verdicts in this browser. Lasts 1 year. Turning it off erases your saved data.

notes.locationRemoved: We remove location data from photos before saving them. If your photo has a location, we keep only the city or region, never the exact spot.
notes.openAiVerdict: Photos you check are sent to OpenAI to get the verdict.
notes.geocoding: To guess where a hotdog is from, we send the photo's approximate location (rounded to about 1 km) to OpenStreetMap's free geocoding service — only for photos that turn out to be hotdogs.
notes.noTracking: We don't use cookies for tracking or advertising.
notes.deleteAnytime: You can delete everything anytime with “Delete my data”.

updateNotice: This page will be updated with our full policy soon.
